name: ritoko
description: Resumable browser, API and MCP workflows for AI agents. Verify CSV/Excel batches and review uncertain writes.

interface.longDescription: Record a browser task once and save it as a workflow. Replay new CSV or Excel data with a local deterministic runner, verify each result, and resume after interruption. Ritoko journals commits before dispatch and holds uncertain submissions for review. Requires Node 24+ and a local MCP client. Direct browser workflows use local Chrome; API-only workflows do not need a browser. Host browser replay requires a client that permits page-script execution.
defaultPrompt: Record this browser task as a Ritoko workflow
Rerun my Ritoko workflow with this CSV
